text:
Mira K.: rolling out slo-tuner v1 as a canary on route chat-completions (tier=prod). Targeting p95=220ms. watching batch formation + kernel fallback behavior and KV cache hit-rate. canary tag: slo-tuner/canary-202403
Alejandro R.: saw a small regression on small microbatches -> kernel fallback picks generic softmax which spikes cpu at tail. profile snippet:
```
2024-03-18T10:12:34Z cpu% 92 softmax_generic
kernel: matrix_mixed_fast available=false
```
Priya S.: kv cache serializer changed in last patch, might be causing partial misses for cached prefixes (headers differ by 1 byte). log example:
```
WARN kv_cache: miss key=route:chat:abcd header_v=2 expected=3
```
Ben T.: proposed tuner config (suggested):
```
{slo_tuner: {p95_target_ms: 220, route_tiers: {prod: 1.0, canary: 0.6, low: 0.4}, min_batch_tokens: 24, max_batch_tokens: 1024, kv_hit_threshold: 0.9}}
```
Mira K.: @sre-bot can you enable trace hooks for the canary and route the 10% traffic to canary-eu? also tag metric alert for kv_hit_rate<0.88
sre-bot: deploying slo-tuner/canary-202403 to eu-west-1 (10% traffic). traces enabled. rollout id=rt-8921
Alejandro R.: quick local perf (simulated traffic): p95 baseline=210ms, canary initial=245ms, after kernel tweak=218ms. KV hit-rate dropped from 0.96 -> 0.87 in canary
Priya S.: if kv_hit_rate < 0.88 we should rollback. command to rollback:
```
./deploy rollback slo-tuner/canary-202403 --id rt-8921
```
Ben T.: alternative: change kernel selection threshold to prefer matmul_fused when batch_token_count < 64. config:
```
kernel_prefetch_threshold_ms: 6
prefer_fused_for_tokens_lt: 64
```
Mira K.: ok, plan: Alejandro will land kernel selection tweak, Priya will patch kv serializer or provide compatibility shim, Ben will update tuner config. we'll reconvene in 2h. :thumbsup:
Priya S.: will open follow-up issue: #perf-rt-457 (compat shim + regression test)
